queue.why: Tom's own game, shipping first by his call.

Wheelthrown has the deepest pull of the three: the drying-clay and slip-splash twist makes every merge a placement decision, runs last 3 to 5 minutes, and lifetime glaze unlocks give a reason to come back, and its screenshots (a 42,000-point board with a full shelf of fired amphorae) sell it. It also rides the fastest-growing casual subgenre (merge) and its matte moss-and-terracotta merge board looks and plays nothing like Bank Shot, the neon slingshot golf game we already shipped.
